Customer Service Officer Job at Swift Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Swift Consulting Limited - Our client, an IT firm, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Officer 

Job Location: Ogudu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

SUmmary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a professional, friendly, and customer-focused Customer Service Officer
	The successful candidate will be responsible for attending to customer inquiries, resolving complaints, providing information about the company’s products and services, and ensuring a positive customer experience.
	The desired candidate must have experience in customer service, client support, help desk, or a related role, preferably within an IT or technology environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer inquiries via phone calls, emails, chats, and other communication channels.
	Provide accurate information about the company’s products, services, and solutions.
	Resolve customer complaints and concerns promptly and professionally.
	Follow up with customers to ensure issues are properly resolved.
	Escalate technical or complex issues to the appropriate team when necessary.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, complaints, and resolutions.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with customers.
	Assist customers with basic product or service-related issues.
	Gather customer feedback and communicate recurring concerns to the relevant team.
	Prepare regular reports on customer inquiries, complaints, and service activities.
	Maintain a professional and customer-friendly approach at all times.


Requirements


	Minimum of an HND/BSc Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
	2-3 years of experience in customer service, client support, help desk, or a similar role.
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills.
	Good knowledge of customer service principles and practices.
	Ability to handle difficult customers professionally and patiently.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital communication tools.
	Ability to learn and explain technology products or services effectively.
	Must be organized, proactive, patient, and customer-focused.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and one-page cover letter to: [email protected] using "Customer Service Officer" as the subject of the email.

Senior Accountant Job at Recare Limited




        
    

        
        Recare is a leader in the marketing of Personal style products in Africa. With operations in Nigeria and South Africa, we provide key products and solutions to the beauty industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Accountant 

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a highly skilled individuals with excellent management skills and industry knowledge to drive our mission to empower individuals to embrace their unique sense of style.
	The Accountant will prepare the company financial accounting, treasury management, provision of management and statutory reports, and support the organization’s business planning and performance management processes.


Responsibilities


	Maintain the general ledger and all related accounts with proper documentation and recording of transactions; review entries to the general and subsidiary ledger to assure accuracy and compliance with the company accounting procedures.
	Prepare monthly and year-end closing of the books and provision of financial reports for management and statutory purposes.
	Implement the company’s chart of accounts and accounting system (policies, procedures, technology) for effective financial reporting and control.
	Support the external audit process by ensuring availability of all required financial and non-financial records.
	Implement a cost accounting system (standard costs, actual costs, investigation of variances) for effective cost management.


Qualifications


	HND in Accounting with 10 -15years of experience in the Manufacturing industry.
	Must be proficient in the use of MS Office Software
	Must have ICAN & other related certifications.


Competencies:


	Strong Communication Skills
	Time Management
	Interpersonal Skills
	Problem Solving Analysis.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candiates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Customer Success & Front Desk Executive Job at Intavalto Nigeria Ltd




        
    

        
        Intavalto Nigeria Ltd is a diversified technology company based in Abuja, Nigeria, specializing in smart home automation, renewable energy products, and infrastructure solutions.

We support both public and private sector clients across Sub-Saharan Africa, offering services that range from planning and design to financing, construction, operations and maintenance of critical infrastructure projects. We're committed to technical excellence, sustainability and innovation, leveraging a skilled and diverse workforce.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Success & Front Desk Executive 

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Description


	The Customer Success & Front Desk Executive serves as the first point of contact and front-facing representative of Intavalto Nigeria Limited, engaging with visitors, clients, partners, vendors, employeesand other stakeholders.
	The role is responsible for delivering a consistently professional, welcomingand high-quality customer experience across the reception, telephone, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels.
	Beyond reception and administrative duties, the successful candidate must be articulate, well-spoken, courteous, presentable,customer-oriented, with the professionalism requiredto represent the company independently.


Responsibilities
The successful candidate is expected to:


	Maintain a consistently professional, polishedand presentable appearance appropriate for a corporate environment.
	Demonstrate excellent verbal communication and conversational skills.
	Exercise discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, or internal company information.
	Demonstrate good telephone, WhatsApp, email, and general written communication etiquette.
	Be attentive to detail and able to identify and respond to customer needs without constant supervision.
	Represent Intavalto's brand and corporate image positively in every interaction.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Hospitality, or a related field.
	1–3 years of experience in customer service, front desk, reception, hospitality, client relations, or a similar customer-facing role.
	Excellent spoken and written E nglish with strong articulation, grammar, vocabulary, and conversational ability.
	Must be confident and comfortable engaging with customers, visitors, executives, and other stakeholders.
	Must possess a polished and professional appearance suitable for a corporate environment.
	Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport quickly with different types of people.
	Demonstrated ability to remain calm, courteous, and professional under pressure.
	Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
	Ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
	Strong sense of responsibility, punctuality, and reliability.


Salary
N165,000 - N180,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Customer Success" as the subject of the email.
